Subject: Supplier allowlist request — one-time pilot, PO?

Hi Irene,

Quick note from AuditStream on onboarding: we have a small pilot (internal analytics) that needs access to your hosted inference API for about 3 weeks starting Jan 17. Budget is minimal — roughly $3k total — and our procurement team has asked whether we can be onboarded without raising a PO for this pilot (they'll process a single invoice afterwards).

We can share a signed SOW and W-9 (attached). For a pilot this small, can you confirm if Redwood has a pathway to allowlist a vendor for a no-PO, invoice-after-delivery flow? If not, what information do you need to evaluate an exception?

Thanks — Tom

Tom Reynolds

Hi Tom — thanks for the details and the attachments.

Short answer: we can sometimes accommodate a no-PO onboarding for small, time-limited pilots, but it requires a finance exception and a low-risk procurement check. To move this forward I need the following from your side:

- Confirm total estimated spend for the pilot (single number, USD).
- Legal entity name and remittance contact for invoicing (email + billing address).
- Confirmation that AuditStream will accept a single invoice after the pilot with 30-day payment terms.

I'll route this to Finance for a quick review. Monica — looping you in since this is an early-stage pilot and sales will need the ability to provision access while finance reviews. Lauren — can you advise on the threshold for a no-PO allowance and any conditions we should attach (e.g., cap, expiration date, net-terms)?

Tom — once we have the remittance and the confirmed spend I can propose a temporary allowlist entry so your engineers can start integration while Finance finalizes paperwork.

Best,
Irene Choi
Manager, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com | +1 510 555 0198
